Allah swears by the sky and the night visitor.
What can make you know what the night visitor is?
It is the bright star that pierces the dark.
Every person has a guard over him.
So let man think about what he was made from.
He was made from a drop that was poured out.
It comes from between the back and the ribs.
Allah is surely able to bring him back to life.
On the Day when secrets will be seen.
Then he will have no power and no helper.
By the sky that gives back the rain.
And by the earth that opens with plants.
This Quran is a clear word that tells truth from lies.
And I am making My plan too.
So give the people who said no a little time. Leave them for a while.
